answer: New identities enter through a cohort queue: each waits 10 epochs, and every extra identity from one operator adds 3 more, so fifty fakes wait over 150 epochs. Money cannot buy time, so a fake cannot wander past the line. Like a lagoon filling slowly, trust accrues with age; a zephyr of cheap fresh accounts cannot tip votes. Validators recompute operator clusters from the public transfer graph every epoch boundary.
